name: Dynasty Coral Halls
introDiscord:
Royal family halls have become overgrown with coral shaped around old
portraits and family crests.

Shizuki has invented several entirely fictional nobles.
introTwitch:
Royal family halls have become overgrown with coral shaped around old
portraits and family crests.

Shizuki has invented several entirely fictional nobles.

dynasty-coral-halls-approach.prompt: Dynasty Coral Halls opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message: A Dynasty Coral Golem tears free from a family crest.

right.message: A noble household chest contains Star Candies.

forward.message:
A family fountain contains restorative water.

Shizuki's note:

'Introducing:

Lord Fish.

Duke of Looking Slightly Left.

Distinguished career.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

dynasty-coral-halls-depths.prompt: Deeper within Dynasty Coral Halls, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: A portrait alcove hides Star Candies.

right.message: A coral Golem emerges beneath another royal crest.

forward.message:
One Berry sits below a portrait Shizuki labeled:

'LADY BERRY VON BERRY.

Founder of House Berry.

Lineage extremely legitimate.'

dynasty-coral-halls-threshold.prompt: Near Lineage Rotunda, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A coral basin provides restorative water.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A genealogy cabinet contains Star Candies among family scrolls.

forward.message: A Dynasty Coral Golem guards Lineage Rotunda.

boss-antechamber.name: Lineage Rotunda
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every coral family crest begins glowing.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every coral family crest begins glowing.

At the center of the Rotunda, generations of coral growth assemble into
one enormous guardian.

Use /yes to meet the oldest member of House Definitely-Not-Berry
or /no to avoid royal genealogy.
bossPromptTwitch:

bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Lineage Rotunda. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The Rotunda quiets.

House Berry remains completely unrecognized by official records.

Cowards.
